title: Rijksregeling welzijn minderheden 1986-1987
authors: Penninx, R., Dommele, P. van, Rooi, F. de, Rijksuniversiteit Utrecht * Utrecht, Vakgroep stadsstudies (primary investigator)
contributors: Ministerie van welzijn, volksgezondheid en cultuur * Rijswijk (research initiator)
descriptions: Evaluation of the functioning of the state regulation for the well-being of minorities. Municipalities, welfare services, categorial foundations and minority organizations were asked to assess the effects of the state regulation for the well-being of minorities ( Rijksregeling Welzijn Minderheden, RWM ), that was introduced in 1985. Policy towards minorities / financial conditions / budget / decentralization / participation of ethnic or cultural minorities in policy formation / accessibility of general welfare institutions for minorities.
